sarif-2.1.0.json is the SARIF Version 2.1.0 JSON Schema published by OASIS
(Static Analysis Results Interchange Format (SARIF) Version 2.1.0 Plus Errata 01,
OASIS Standard).

Copyright (c) OASIS Open 2020. All Rights Reserved.

The schema is distributed under the OASIS Intellectual Property Rights Policy
(https://www.oasis-open.org/policies-guidelines/ipr/) and the copyright notice in
the "Notices" section of the SARIF Version 2.1.0 specification
(https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/sarif-v2.1.0-errata01-os-complete.html).
The file is kept byte for byte as published and is only used to validate the
SARIF output of the ozen command.
